discrimination.binding_required: a receipt naming the pair fixture's sha256, the mutation rule and the scoring rule; until then the endpoint is registered and unusable
discrimination.endpoint: candidate-ranking accuracy: the fraction of registered pairs in which the model assigns a higher likelihood to the correct candidate than to a mutated one
discrimination.never_pooled_with: the absolute primary endpoint, and never pooled across categories
discrimination.why: no pair fixture exists and no receipt binds one, so no discrimination number may be reported

endpoint.decision_rule: WIN iff the paired 95% CI lower bound is at or above the minimum absolute effect. Per-category regressions beyond 0.05 absolute are reported and block a transfer claim; they are not a conjunct of the primary, because the conjunct is measured to cost about a quarter of the decision power at the same effect.
endpoint.estimand: category-balanced mean verified task success, paired
endpoint.minimum_absolute_effect_derivation: ceil(max(planning MDE, conservative MDE) at the registered n to the next 0.01); the conservative variance is the one that must be reachable, so the minimum is set from it

old_endpoint_unreachable.statement: a 10% relative effect at the measured baseline needs the required n above per category; the suite registers the per-category minimum printed beside it

supersedes.reason: the 10%-relative endpoint cannot be resolved at any feasible item count on this instrument; the endpoint becomes an absolute effect whose minimum is derived from the measured variance at the registered n
